# Work brief — release readiness for the fixture service

Prepare a release-readiness checklist for the fixture service.

Required items, in order:
1. Build passes.
2. Unit tests pass.
3. Migration dry-run succeeds.
4. Rollback plan is written.
5. On-call owner is named.

Write the checklist to checklist.md, one row per item, with a status column left as PENDING.
